name: ai-companion
description: A 3D desktop robot that walks on your screen, chats through Ollama, and talks and listens in Thai

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:native
scripts.build:native: command -v swiftc >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ build/keytap -nt src/native/keytap.swift ] || (mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -o build/keytap src/native/keytap.swift)
